## Section 1: System Overview & Zero-Egress Core Invariants

Zoth Studio v2 is a local-first development studio designed for orchestrating autonomous AI agent pantheons, local model foundries (Ollama, llama.cpp), and biomorphic synaptic memory matrices. All prompts, code ASTs, secrets, and weights execute strictly on local loopback enclaves (127.0.0.1) with zero cloud telemetry or external data exfiltration.

Zero-Egress Architectural Invariants:
1. Local Silicon Guarantee: No external network calls (HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC) are dispatched during code execution, analysis, or prompt inference.
2. Cryptographic Enclave: Keys are derived via Argon2id (memory hard) and secrets encrypted using XChaCha20-Poly1305 / AES-256-GCM.
3. No Cloud Fallbacks: In the absence of remote APIs, the system falls back to local models or deterministic in-browser engines rather than failing open to third-party endpoints.
4. Deterministic AST Verification: Code modifications pass through a 3-agent Byzantine consensus arena prior to staging.
5. Honest Runtime Reflection: The hosted client app at https://zoth.nullai.tech never fakes active loopback connections; hardware daemons are clearly labeled with loopback probes when run locally.

## Section 2: Lucy Cognitive Oracle & Whitespace Memory Matrix (STDP)

Guardian: Lucy
Role: Sovereign Cognitive Memory Oracle & Agent Knowledge Guide
Channel: Semantic Bus :8094 // Zero-Egress Memory Stratum
Theme: Whitespace Cyberspace — a serene, luminous, non-hectic memory void with gold-on-void (#D4AF37 on #08080B) and Editorial Ivory (#FAF7F0) visual ergonomics.

Biomorphic Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) Synaptic Equation:
The neural memory engine computes synaptic adjustments for knowledge vectors using exponential spike-timing windows:

  For pre-synaptic spike arriving before post-synaptic retrieval (Δt > 0, Long-Term Potentiation):
    Δw = A₊ · exp(-Δt / τ₊)

  For post-synaptic retrieval before confirmation (Δt < 0, Long-Term Depression):
    Δw = -A₋ · exp(Δt / τ₋)

Key Hyperparameters:
- A₊ (Potentiation Constant): 1.0 (default maximum synaptic weight burst)
- A₋ (Depression Constant): 1.05 (asymmetric penalty preventing memory saturation)
- τ₊ (Potentiation Time Window): 20.0 ms
- τ₋ (Depression Time Window): 20.0 ms
- Baseline Decay Factor: Logarithmic stale-vector pruning after 14-day inactivity
- Synaptic Storage: SQLite vec0 / HNSW table running on loopback at http://127.0.0.1:8094 (when local repo daemon is active)

## Section 3: The Six Mathematical Pillars of Zoth

PILLAR I: LINEAR ALGEBRA
- Numeral: I
- Subtitle: Tensors, Projections, Geometry, and Scaled Dot-Product Attention
- Formula: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q · Kᵀ) / √d_k) · V
- Metrics: d_model = 2048 / 4096; h = 16 / 32 heads; d_k = 128

PILLAR II: MULTIVARIABLE CALCULUS
- Numeral: II
- Subtitle: Gradients, Loss Optimization, and Momentum
- Formula: θ_{t+1} = θ_t - η · m_t / (√(v_t) + ε)  [AdamW update]
- Metrics: Learning rate η = 3.0 × 10⁻⁴; β₁ = 0.90; β₂ = 0.999; norm clip = 1.0

PILLAR III: PROBABILITY & INFORMATION THEORY
- Numeral: III
- Subtitle: Logit Distributions, Shannon Entropy, and Sampling
- Formula: H(X) = -Σ P(x) · log₂ P(x) ; P(w_i) = exp(z_i / τ) / Σ exp(z_j / τ)
- Metrics: Temperature τ = 0.70; Top-p = 0.90; Shannon Entropy H = 1.482 bits

PILLAR IV: OPTIMIZATION & LOSS LANDSCAPES (HESSIAN)
- Numeral: IV
- Subtitle: Curvature, Condition Numbers, and Saddle-Point Escaping
- Formula: H = ∇²L(θ) ; Δθ ≈ -H⁻¹ · ∇L(θ)  [Newton-Raphson curvature step]
- Metrics: Spectral norm λ_max/λ_min = 142.6; Saddle-point threshold ε = 10⁻⁵

PILLAR V: DYNAMICAL SYSTEMS & ATTRACTOR NETWORKS (LYAPUNOV)
- Numeral: V
- Subtitle: Phase Space, Hamiltonian Orbits, and Lyapunov Stability
- Formula: V̇(x) = (∇V(x))ᵀ · f(x) ≤ 0 ; λ = lim_{t→∞} (1/t) · ln(||δx(t)|| / ||δx(0)||)
- Metrics: Damping γ = 0.05; Phase space dimension D = 256; Symplectic step Δt = 0.01

PILLAR VI: NEUROMORPHIC SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY (STDP)
- Numeral: VI
- Subtitle: Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity & STDP Memory Adaptation
- Formula: Δw = A₊ · e^(-Δt/τ₊) (Δt ≥ 0) | Δw = -A₋ · e^(Δt/τ₋) (Δt < 0)
- Metrics: τ₊ = 20.0 ms; τ₋ = 20.0 ms; A₊ = 1.0; A₋ = 1.05

## Section 4: The 21 Swarm Pantheon & Consensus Arena

The 21-Agent Swarm Pantheon is organized into five operational cadres:
1. Architects Cadre: Azoth (Prime Architect :8790), Sophia (Philosophical Blueprint), Janus (Duality & Edge Cases), Chronos (Temporal Orchestrator)
2. Code Cadre: Daedalus (Foundry Engineer), Vulcan (Compiler & Transpiler), Prometheus (API Synthesizer), Hephaestus (Hardware Interface)
3. Security Cadre: Lycan (Enclave Sentinel :8787), Cerberus (Zero-Egress Firewall), Aegis (Integrity Watchdog), Minotaur (Obfuscation Breaker)
4. Creative Cadre: Apollo (Visual Aesthetics), Calliope (Narrative Voice), Thoth (Documentation Scribe), Hermes (Signal Messenger :8102)
5. Swarm Cadre: Lucy (Netrunner Memory Oracle :8094), Mnemosyne (Episodic Archivist), Morpheus (Latent State Explorer), Veritas (AST Verifier), Atlas (Resource Balancer)

Consensus Battle Arena Protocol:
- Topology: Triadic Byzantine consensus (Proposer, Evaluator, Arbiter).
- Mechanism: AST Diff Synthesis requiring a 2/3 signed cryptographic quorum before code is staged or merged.
